name: Bob Navigation Hotkeys
description: Ctrl+Shift+P always opens the Task Card, a focused first screen with exact P-level previews; Esc, q, or Ctrl+[ close it without writing, and its More section opens a property's value stage. Open and manage related notes, tabs, and task properties, including priority levels that roll scheduled dates. Ctrl+Enter on the card takes the recommended roll, decay, or cancel from the previewed ladder, including counted and Task Link batches. Scheduling a date opens one combined Reason and Work summary review; a Pending or Next task can record an optional Work Log summary as a dated entry under a WORK LOG child. A Cancel action closes tasks as Cancelled with an optional reason kept in a first-child Cancel Log. Alt+F and Ctrl+Alt+F ask for an optional Work Log summary before refreshing Pending tasks. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the review walk just landed on completes it and advances within the group when another live row remains (nav api v3).
author: Bryan
